responsibility: Implements the D front end’s compile-time function evaluator. This file owns the CTFE execution engine, including the interpreter stack and frame model for variables and `this`, statement and expression interpretation entry points, recursion limits, caching of global constant values, support for selected runtime/library intrinsics during interpretation, propagation of CTFE exceptions and control-flow markers, and helper routines for running postblits and destructors on interpreted aggregate values.
